answer:
Because the column budget (`max_columns`) is per call, not per query. `runBatch` installs it once for the whole stream (`out_json.max_columns = gopts.max_columns orelse 0`, src/main.zig:1966). A query cannot set it in "flags", and it isn't copied into each query's argv (src/main.zig:1963-1965).

If `runSearch` reset it to 0 for every query, it would wipe the batch's value. So `runSearch` only clears it when `!batch_running` (src/main.zig:2038). `batch_running` is set to true for the duration of `runBatch` (src/main.zig:1961-1962).

The later assignment follows the same rule: inside a batch it keeps the existing `out_json.max_columns`, otherwise it uses `opts.max_columns orelse 0` (src/main.zig:2117-2120). The comments call this an intentional exception (src/main.zig:2032-2034).
